admin.notice: Local demonstration administration, with no real account. Changes apply to this browser only.
admin.liveTitle: One house, one set of data.
admin.liveBody: A booking removes a room from availability; cancellation releases it. Rates, extras and closures saved here are used by the public website, including in other tabs.
admin.calendarHelp: Each cell shows free rooms out of the total. Scenario closures and local bookings are included.
admin.noBookings: Bookings created in the engine will appear here.
admin.blockHelp: The closure applies to the first rooms in the category. It is rejected if it overlaps a confirmed booking.
admin.rateHelp: The last rate saved for a night overrides season and weekend pricing. Already confirmed bookings keep their price.
admin.seasonBody: November to March: base rate. April, May, September and October: +18%. June: +30%. July and August: +50% and a three-night minimum. Friday and Saturday: +7%. Two-night minimum outside summer, unless a custom rate period applies.
admin.extraHelp: Changes apply to new quotes. Already confirmed stays remain unchanged.
admin.extraPrice: Adult or flat price, in euros
admin.promoHelp: Offers apply to accommodation at the flexible rate only. Codes remain the same in all five languages.
admin.contentHelp: You are editing this language version only. An empty field keeps the original text. Content is treated as text, never as code.
admin.providerTitle: Independent today. Ready to connect tomorrow.
admin.providerBody: This version uses the local provider. Bookings never leave this browser. The original WordPress Beds24 connector is preserved; a server-side API V2 adapter and a shared data contract are supplied for a production installation.
admin.providerLimits: No Beds24 credentials are loaded here. The adapter is tested with simulated responses; live access, permissions, writes and property rules must still be validated with an authorised account.
admin.resetBody: This removes Casa Suprana stays, table and activity bookings, edited rates, menus, offers and content in this browser. The original examples are restored without touching other projects.
admin.resetDone: The demonstration data has been reset.
admin.newData: Data changed in another tab. Refresh this view to see it.
site.subtitle: A coastal house · Cap Corse
home.eyebrow: A different side of Cap Corse.
home.title: The luxury of time, rediscovered.
home.intro: Eighteen rooms, an endless sea and that rare feeling: nothing more is needed.
home.caption: A Mediterranean escape, between sea and wild hills.
home.houseTitle: Far from the noise. Close to what matters.
home.houseBody: At the edge of a garden sloping towards the sea, Casa Suprana feels like a house that already knows you. Stone keeps the rooms cool, pines cast their shade and each day finds its own rhythm. Here, care is measured in the things you barely notice.
home.roomsTitle: Rooms to make your own, not just pass through.
home.roomsIntro: From the quiet garden to a terrace open to the horizon, four ways to feel far away.
home.tableBody: At La Table, the market sets the pace. Mediterranean fish, vegetables picked that morning, olive oil with a sense of place: thoughtful cooking, without ceremony.
home.spaBody: A sauna, unhurried treatments, the scent of pine. Sous les Pins invites you to leave an hour unplanned. Perhaps two.
home.regionTitle: Cap Corse is not a checklist. It is an encounter.
home.regionBody: A quiet side road, a tower above the water, a village at siesta time. Leave room for the unexpected: that is often where the journey begins.
cta.title: What if you made time?
cta.body: Choose your dates. The rest can wait.
page.house.title: Quite simply, a house.
page.house.intro: Casa Suprana imagines hospitality on a human scale: eighteen keys, a Mediterranean garden and the sea as the only appointment that matters.
page.house.body: In the morning, shutters open to the light of Cap Corse. You wander down for coffee, find a place in the shade, return to a book left the evening before. Nothing dictates the day. Each space is imagined so that ordinary moments become the ones you take home.
page.house.secondBody: Natural materials, washed linen, pale wood and colours borrowed from the landscape. The garden uses little water; bathroom amenities are refillable. These are design choices for this fictional hotel, with no environmental certification claimed.
page.rooms.title: Your place in the house.
page.rooms.intro: Four characters, the same care. Eighteen rooms and suites to wake up overlooking the garden or the sea.
room.garden.name: Garden Room
room.sea.name: Sea Room
room.terrace.name: Terrace Suite
room.pines.name: Pine Suite
room.garden.intro: Stone, linen and a garden to wake up to. An intimate room for two, looking towards the olive trees.
room.garden.body: Across 28 m², a king-size bed, a discreet desk and a softly lit shower room create an easy retreat. A seat beside the window becomes the perfect place to slow down. Six rooms belong to this category, each welcoming one or two adults.
room.sea.intro: Open the shutters. Find the horizon. A private balcony for the first coffee and the last light.
room.sea.body: Across 32 m², the room lets the landscape take centre stage. The king-size bed faces the window; natural materials continue into the shower room. Six rooms welcome up to two guests, including at most one child within the room’s total capacity.
room.terrace.intro: Inside, the calm of wood. Outside, a terrace of your own. A suite for making every hour last.
room.terrace.body: Forty-eight square metres, a separate living area, a bathtub and a private terrace create a generous retreat. The four suites welcome up to three guests, with at most three adults or one child, never exceeding three guests in total.
room.pines.intro: A house within the house. Two bedrooms and a living room to travel together, with room of your own.
room.pines.body: The two Pine Suites offer 62 m² and an outlook onto the garden. They welcome at most four guests, including up to two children. A main bedroom, a second bedroom and a bathroom with a bathtub give families and friends room to settle in.
page.restaurant.title: The landscape, on your plate.
page.restaurant.intro: La Table celebrates the best of Cap Corse: the morning market, Mediterranean fish and the pleasure of meals that linger.
page.restaurant.body: The menu follows the season, not the other way round. Roasted fennel, the day’s catch, citrus and olive oil make a cuisine with little need for embellishment. In the evening, the terrace takes on the colours of the sea. A vegetarian option receives the same attention.
restaurant.menu1: Roasted fennel, preserved lemon, Cap Corse olive oil
restaurant.menuPrice: Illustrative menu · {price} per person, excluding drinks.
restaurant.hours: Breakfast every day, 07:30–10:30. Restaurant Tuesday to Sunday: lunch 12:00–14:30, dinner 19:30–22:00.
restaurant.contact: Prepare an enquiry for La Table
page.spa.title: Sous les Pins. Beyond time.
page.spa.intro: A place to let your shoulders drop, find your breath and allow the day to unfold.
page.spa.body: The sauna sets the scene for rest; a quiet space lets the ritual linger. The 60-minute signature experience can be added to your stay for each adult. For the rest of the day, settle in, breathe and rediscover the pleasure of taking your time.
spa.hours: Wellness area 10:00–19:00 · Ritual by simulated appointment, adults only.
spa.add: Add a ritual to my stay
page.experiences.title: No two days alike.
page.experiences.intro: Walk before the heat, follow the coast, return through a village. A few ideas, and all the freedom to change your mind.
experience.walk.title: The morning trail
experience.walk.body: An independent walk through wild hills and viewpoints. Bring water, wear suitable shoes and check local conditions; no real guide is booked here.
experience.village.title: Time for the villages
experience.village.body: Nonza’s lanes and its silhouette above the sea make you want to put the camera down and simply look.
experience.sea.title: The sea, without a schedule
experience.sea.body: Sometimes a book, a terrace and the horizon are enough. Water activities are not sold in this demonstration; the fictional team would help you plan a suitable outing.
page.offers.title: Good reasons to stay.
page.offers.intro: Thoughtful offers, clear conditions. Every offer is calculated directly in the booking engine.
offer.avelune.title: A little longer away
offer.avelune.body: {percent}% off accommodation for stays of {minimum} nights or more, at the flexible rate. Code {code}. Cannot be combined with the non-refundable rate.
offer.week.title: A week at the pace of Cap Corse
offer.week.body: {percent}% off accommodation for stays of {minimum} nights or more, at the flexible rate. Code {code}. Give your journey a few more days.
page.gallery.title: Light, to remember.
page.gallery.intro: Places, textures, moments. A selection of illustrative photographs to imagine the world of Casa Suprana.
page.region.title: An island within the island.
page.region.intro: Cap Corse unfolds in villages, hills and coastlines. An invitation to explore slowly, without trying to see it all.
page.region.body: From the western coast, roads wind towards Nonza and the inland villages. Stop for a shaded square, a pink façade, a view you had not expected. At Albo, evening leaves a light on the water you wish you could keep. Cap Corse lends itself to days without a checklist, when the journey matters as much as the destination.
page.information.title: Simply, a well-prepared stay.
page.information.intro: A few helpful details, from arrival to that last coffee.
faq.arrival.q: When can I check in and check out?
faq.arrival.a: Check-in is from 16:00 and check-out is before 11:00. These times are part of the fictional hotel scenario.
faq.children.a: Yes, in room categories with suitable capacity. The engine distinguishes adults from children aged 0–12; the total can never exceed the room’s capacity.
faq.pets.a: In the Casa Suprana scenario, pets are not accepted. Accessibility or assistance requirements would need to be discussed with a real hotel before booking.
faq.conditions.q: How do rates and cancellations work?
faq.conditions.a: Amounts vary by season, weekend, guests and extras. The flexible rate allows free changes until three days before arrival. The non-refundable rate takes 8% off accommodation. All conditions are shown again before fictional confirmation.
page.contact.title: Every thoughtful stay begins with a conversation.
page.contact.intro: Prepare a trial enquiry about a stay, La Table or wellness. No message is sent to a real hotel.
contact.success: Your trial enquiry is ready. On a real site, it would be sent to the team. No message was sent and no personal data was collected here.
page.booking.title: Your next memory starts here.
page.booking.intro: Your dates, your room, your extras. A simple journey from the first choice to confirmation.
page.manage.title: Your bookings, made simple.
page.manage.intro: A stay, a table or an activity: find your reference, adjust your booking or review its conditions.
page.admin.title: The Casa Suprana workshop.
page.admin.intro: Manage stays, availability and rates in your local demonstration.
page.legal.title: A concept, with complete transparency.
page.legal.intro: Casa Suprana is a fictional hotel created by TheCatsizerLab to present a hotel experience and booking engine.
legal.body: This site does not sell stays. Addresses, services and availability describe a demonstration scenario; no real booking or payment is made. Static hosting: GitHub Pages. Photographs show different real places with no affiliation to the concept. Original code and content are by TheCatsizerLab; images and fonts retain their respective licences and attributions.
page.privacy.title: Peace of mind, including your data.
page.privacy.intro: The demonstration uses fictional profiles and local storage in your browser only.
privacy.body: Trial bookings, rates, closures and edited content are stored in IndexedDB, in the avelune-hotel-demo database. They are sent neither to Beds24 nor to a hotel. Tabs in the same browser share this data. Resetting from administration removes only this demonstration’s examples. No analytics, advertising pixel, remote font or tracking cookie is added. The host handles technical requests under its own policy. Data may disappear if storage is cleared or blocked.
page.accessibility.title: A stay begins with straightforward access.
page.accessibility.intro: Keyboard navigation, readable contrast, labelled forms and respect for motion preferences are built into the design.
accessibility.body: Automated and visual checks are described in the technical report. They do not constitute a full RGAA audit or certification. Availability tables have a labelled scroll area; photographs have text alternatives; errors and confirmations do not rely on colour alone. Physical accessibility refers to a fictional hotel and is not a promise of real facilities.
page.credits.title: The eyes behind the images.
page.credits.intro: Photographs are used under their respective licences. They illustrate a fictional hotel and do not depict a single property.
credits.modifications: Resizing, photographic cropping and WebP conversion. No text added to images.

page.tableBooking.intro: A menu, a date and the pleasure of coming together. Choose your sitting to see available tables.
page.activityBooking.title: Your next memorable escape.
page.activityBooking.intro: A walk, time at sea or the flavours of Cap Corse. Book your places on the house’s activities.
